definitions.explanation: A company that provides insurance products including life insurance, health insurance, auto insurance, and property insurance.

examples.japanese: {保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}た→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧。
examples.english: After the accident, I filed a report with the insurance company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見積|みつ}もり→見積もり：05153_mitsumori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I compared quotes from several insurance companies before deciding.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ (insurance) and {会社|がいしゃ} (company). Insurance is a significant industry in Japan, and dealings with insurance companies are a common part of adult life — from car accidents and health matters to life insurance and home insurance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧: to sign up with an insurance company
- {保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}する→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧: to file a claim with an insurance company
- {保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧: to inquire with an insurance company
- {保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧: insurance company representative

TYPES OF INSURANCE:
- ⟦{生命|せいめい}{保険|ほけん}→生命保険：18637_seimeihoken⟧: life insurance
- ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}→自動車保険：26400_jidoushahoken⟧: auto insurance
- ⟦{火災|かさい}{保険|ほけん}→火災保険：20282_kasaihoken⟧: fire insurance
- ⟦{医療|いりょう}{保険|ほけん}→医療保険：21128_iryouhoken⟧: medical insurance
- ⟦{損害|そんがい}{保険|ほけん}→損害保険：20874_songaihoken⟧: property/casualty insurance
